title: Machine-learning models predicted bleeding and cardiovascular events after PCI for acute myocardial infarction
summary: The retrospective clinical study developed and evaluated prognostic models for hemorrhage and major cardiovascular events after percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with acute myocardial infarction. The model estimates risk from the study cohort; it does not show that using predictions improves outcomes.
ai_technology: Machine-learning prognostic models for hemorrhage and major cardiovascular events after PCI.
organization: Tianjin Chest Hospital; Tianjin Medical University

evidence.tested: Primary cohort analyses evaluated prediction of hemorrhage and major cardiovascular adverse events after intervention.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective, cohort-specific prognostic evaluation; prospective utility and external generalization are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning prognostic models for hemorrhage and major cardiovascular events after PCI.
